{{Quote|Dedra Meero contacted a friend of mine in Tactical last night. She's looking for a team to be put together for an operation in Coruscant.|Lonni Jung, to Luthen Rael|<ref name="Stop" /> }}
The [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Lonni Jung]] had a '''friend''' who was a member of [[ISB Tactical]], a task force of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 BBY]], the individual was contacted by ISB Supervisor [[Dedra Meero]], who was attempting to assemble a team of Tactical forces for an [[Raid on the Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest|operation]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. Due to Meero's reputation for bending the rules, the individual contacted his friend, asking Jung if he felt it was safe to comply. Jung, secretly a [[Axis network|rebel]] [[spy]], deduced that Meero had located the leader of the rebel network, namely the [[human]] [[Luthen Rael]]. Instead of responding to the friend, Jung, who had recently used stolen Meero's code cert and used it to view classified files, contacted Rael and arranged a secret meeting. In a park on Coruscant, Jung explained that Rael was in danger, citing the query from his friend in Tactical about an upcoming operation led by Meero. Rael would soon [[Death|kill]] Jung after learning the classified intelligence he had discovered. Meanwhile, Meero's operation was put into motion, and the supervisor visited Rael's shop, [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]], to capture him.<ref name="Stop" />
